## Booking

Book flights and hotels in the travel tool. Questions go to {% slack_channel "travel-help" %}, and the full rules are on the [reimbursement page]({% page "/travel/reimbursement/" %}).

## Foreign travel

Before a personal trip abroad, complete the foreign travel notification form. Within five days of returning, complete the debriefing form.
